# Results

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

library(ggplot2)
nhanes_women <- read.csv("nhanes_women.csv")
women_brf <- read.csv("women_brf.csv")

```

```{r}

ggplot(nhanes_women, aes(x = age, fill = cycle)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution of Women by NHANES Cycle",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)



```
```{r}
ggplot(nhanes_women, aes(x = age, fill = cycle)) +
  geom_histogram(
    color    = "blue",
    fill     = "lightblue",
    binwidth = 2,
    boundary = 0
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cycle, ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous() +  
  labs(
    title = "Age Histogram by NHANES Cycle (Women Only)",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)


```




```{r}
ggplot(nhanes_women, aes(x = bmi, fill = cycle)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "BMI Distribution of Women by NHANES Cycle",
    x = "BMI",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

```

```{r}

ggplot(nhanes_women, aes(x = bmi)) +
  geom_histogram(
    color    = "blue",
    fill     = "lightblue",
    binwidth = 2,
    boundary = 0
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cycle, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "BMI Histogram by NHANES Cycle (Women Only)",
    x     = "BMI",
    y     = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

```



```{r}


ggplot(nhanes_women,
       aes(x = sedentary_min_day,
           y = bmi)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ cycle, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "BMI vs. Sedentary Minutes per Day by Cycle",
    x     = "Sedentary minutes per day",
    y     = "BMI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)




```



```{r}
ggplot(nhanes_women,
       aes(x = sedentary_min_day,
           y = bmi)) +
  geom_bin2d() +
  facet_wrap(~ cycle, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "BMI vs. Sedentary Time (2D Binned Heatmap)",
    x     = "Sedentary minutes per day",
    y     = "BMI",
    fill  = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

```

```{r}





women_pa <- BRF %>%
  filter(
    Year == 2013,                       
    Break_Out_Category == "Sex",
    Break_Out == "Female",
    Response == "Yes"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    state_abbr = Locationabbr,    
    pct_yes    = as.numeric(Data_value)
  )


states_sf <- states(cb = TRUE)


states_joined <- states_sf |>
  left_join(women_pa, by = c("STUSPS" = "state_abbr"))

ggplot(states_joined) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pct_yes), color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "% Yes") +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-125, -66),   # zoom to US
    ylim = c(24, 50),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Women Meeting Physical Activity Guidelines by State",
    subtitle = "CDC BRFSS",
    fill = "% Yes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
